:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](images/14/14671e805c18814b31d0c65d0e53c60aae1cf52c60ad8dd146d8a3f4bc823915.png)
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that every variable has a coefficient:

![](images/e0/e0318c549ab4aa25bf2decb41e45e296406d699706c03aff7ea44724d20edece.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & -2 \
		0 & 2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

:topic/knowledge-points.:knowledge-point/title: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations

:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](images/a5/a5abba041a61cad76d43d5bb13d0fd4e873eb2daf2282e8d9828b8ab79fe2ba0.png)
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](images/2f/2f9ae37920ec528a700715658900bbbf3ec4c855767bf06f79d044f488a8bbf2.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & 1 & -3 \
		-7 & -1 & 1 \
                2 & 1 & -2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](images/af/af1499610c0c312a1f5c50d99967a004ae6b3042c3a88ca20a86f922b28aaaff.png)

:topic/knowledge-points.:knowledge-point/title: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations

:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

![](images/4d/4d90e81043121495ae8bb7742400b2c9e705cb7d706f553a6ab2aec44b35d017.png)
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

:topic/knowledge-points.:knowledge-point/title: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix

:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](images/d8/d89417b7eb2d000bbd81fcf4a89ca7eaa5529fc56d9b41bf6e8bb237d2eb9e16.png)
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c,d$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](images/93/93874fa93cfd9ef3df1492bbc35056c2381157740d8ca26b475474faf54ee4d1.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](images/83/8356d9148bc06d76a5aee41e4a07651c43d94b2496d9542eb8b6e01ee52ea161.png)
